requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market demand for higher yield and reduce frequency of replacements, improving customer satisfaction and cost efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle redesign and compatibility with new IDS and tank system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must be validated to deliver at least 6,000 pages for Black and CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting >8,000 pages in controlled tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure all ink bottles and refilling processes are spill-free to enhance reliability and user experience.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation is critical for customer satisfaction and reducing warranty/service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage observed in 99% of refilling scenarios during reliability testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label into the NOA-F component, with no changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances part reliability, security, and traceability without redesigning key mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing NOA-F design, TDF, push-push mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must pass validation with new labyrinth and lid label while maintaining existing functional interfaces.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Reuse the SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D cost and leverages proven, reliable components.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and IDS systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks must meet all print quality and reliability standards in Magellan platform.

requirements.Title: Enhanced Reliability and Characterization Modeling
requirements.Description: Characterize and model reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, IDS, startup, and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL) parameters.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures system robustness, longevity, and supports warranty claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with IDS, tank, and bottle systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Models must be validated and predictive within +/-10% of observed reliability outcomes in pilot runs.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in tanks and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures long-term print quality and reduces field failures.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design, ink properties, IDS interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability modeling must predict PQ impact over 2-year warranty life with <5% deviation from field data.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts for in-warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and improves customer experience by enabling field replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F service parts available and replaceable within warranty support SLAs.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology into the ink bottle lid for improved traceability or anti-counterfeiting.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product security and traceability in the supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 features must be verifiable on all production lids and pass security audits.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5. Mold 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing capability for new components and bottle designs.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing line configuration, new component designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 and Orcus 5 lines operational with new components and pass production validation.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA and NOA-F to be customer replaceable, enhancing serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F design, service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F using provided instructions with <5% error rate in usability tests.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Set new warranty page life goal for the printer at 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations for durability and reduces TCO for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must operate without critical failure for at least 80,000 pages in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Product Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID for product with increased tank size, while keeping Marconi-HI ADF unchanged.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity and page yield without redesigning ADF.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product ID and tank design validated in pilot production; ADF remains unchanged.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes ISTA transit and drop tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for environmental standards (PDL SKU).
requirements.Rationale: Compliance is necessary for market access and corporate sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel before launch.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with new tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and maintains compact footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly with new tank in user tests and fit within defined product envelope.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3” CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and usability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is functional, clear, and passes user experience tests.

requirements.Title: 4-Tube Platform with New Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes and develop new tube routing and integration for a 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports increased ink flow and reliability with new tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New routing and integration validated in reliability and flow tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for improved aerosol management and adapt platform for tank changes.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance and improves print environment cleanliness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within safety thresholds during operation.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new system configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Carriage design, tube routing, weight distribution.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates reliably and meets print quality standards in system tests.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paperpath design to support increased 80,000-page life goal.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures durability and reliability over extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath passes accelerated life testing for 80,000 pages without critical failure.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product life and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance part within standard service time.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce 140ml black bottles and new, larger CMY bottles for the ink system.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yields and reduces refill frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles validated for compatibility and yield in system tests.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection in IDS
requirements.Description: Develop new make-break and FI (fluidic interconnect) connection for IDS, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, prevents mis-filling, and supports larger tank sizes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Connections pass reliability and mis-fill prevention tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Implement new IDS startup algorithm and air management system.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable startup and air handling for new tank and bottle system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup and air management pass reliability and air ingress tests.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new algorithms for servicing and startup to support new platform requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and user experience with new system components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithms validated in service and startup scenarios with <2% failure rate.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definitions
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion definitions to align with updated page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output quality and accurate yield metrics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion metrics validated in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU hardware in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven hardware to reduce development cost and risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Hardware passes system integration and functional validation.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Provides modern connectivity options for users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module passes connectivity and performance tests.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Utilize Dune firmware platform for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility and leverages existing firmware capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Firmware passes system and feature validation tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Meets enterprise security requirements and protects user data.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware design, compliance standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass penetration and compliance tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise Segments
requirements.Description: Design solutions, services, and business models to address needs of consumer, SMB, and enterprise markets.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports diverse customer requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Feature set, service offerings, pricing models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Solutions and services available and validated for each segment at launch.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Include SMB manageability and enterprise support features such as WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Meets IT requirements for business customers and enhances manageability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Manageability features functional and validated in enterprise test environments.

requirements.Title: Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD Clients & Drivers
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Supports wide range of deployment scenarios and user environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All clients and drivers pass compatibility and installation tests.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and HP's Ink/Laser Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Design product features and pricing to protect HP's micro/SMB segments and profit pool from competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Strategic business objective to maintain market share and profitability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share and profit pool metrics maintained or improved post-launch.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium and Enterprise Segments
requirements.Description: Strategically position LaserJet as lead and PDL as flank in medium and enterprise segments to win over competitors like Epson as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's competitive positioning in the growing CISS market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share in medium/enterprise segments grows versus competitors.

requirements.Title: Grow Profitable CISS Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand CISS offerings to new segments to grow HP's profitable market share.
requirements.Rationale: Increases revenue and market penetration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS share in new segments increases post-launch.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform and Marconi-Hi Product
requirements.Description: Leverage Watt-LE mechanical platform and Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID) for new Magellan solution.
requirements.Rationale: Speeds development and reduces investment by reusing proven platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Platform integration validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks into the new product platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern CISS features and improves product competitiveness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All components function as integrated system in validation tests.

requirements.Title: New NGB Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles for the platform.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents mis-filling and supports new tank and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles prevent mis-filling in >99% test cases.

requirements.Title: Schedule as Constrained Priority
requirements.Description: Adhere to schedule as the least flexible business constraint for the program.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures timely market entry and supports business objectives.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All key milestones met as per published schedule.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K as Constrained Priority
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages as a constrained program requirement.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for warranty, reliability, and cost targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes life testing for 65,000 pages with <1% failure rate.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years and 80,000 Pages as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Optimize for warranty life of 2 years and 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Meets customer expectations for durability and value.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes reliability testing for 2 years/80,000 pages without critical failure.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL) as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Optimize for print throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Competitive performance metric for target market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves rated throughput in standard performance tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box) as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Optimize serviceability, focusing on maintenance box accessibility and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service time and improves customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is replaceable within defined service time.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Optimize product features and solutions for SMB market needs.
requirements.Rationale: Increases product adoption and satisfaction in SMB segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB features validated in customer pilots and feedback.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) as Optimized Priority
requirements.Description: Optimize for PaaS business model and schedule.
requirements.Rationale: Enables new revenue streams and flexible deployment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features operational and validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K as Flexible Priority
requirements.Description: Host 12,000-page CMYK and trade page 6,000 as flexible priorities for the program.
requirements.Rationale: Provides flexibility for future product enhancements or market demands.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 12K-CMYK and 6K trade page features can be enabled as needed.
